root_idea.summary: The root centers on generated heat and intensity, with extensions to ardor, indignation, and protective restriction.
root_idea.development: Heat or vehemence develops figuratively into anger and zealous indignation, and by association into protecting or setting something apart from encroachment.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form I verb, normalized to the classical perfect citation form.
Distinct Quran-attested feminine active participle describing extreme heat.
Distinct Quran-attested abstract noun for indignant or disdainful zeal.

senses.definition: To be heated intensely, especially by fire.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quranic occurrence, the construction describes metal being heated over fire. This is the heat sense, not the separate classical sense of protecting or prohibiting.

senses.definition: A stallion-camel whose back has been set apart and protected from riding or other use.
senses.usage_conditions: A specialized pre-Islamic designation for a breeding stallion regarded as protected; the Quranic usage refers to this customary category.

senses.definition: Intensely hot; burning with extreme heat.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally for something characterized by vehement heat. The lexical discussion also records حَامِيَةٌ for a hot spring in an alternate Quranic reading, but that reading is not included among the supplied QAC occurrences.

senses.definition: Indignant, disdainful zeal or partisan pride.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ, it denotes the heated indignation and pride associated with جاهلية, rather than ordinary protective care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To protect, defend, or guard a person, thing, place, or interest; or to prohibit it from encroachment or use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe protecting people or honor, making a place a protected reserve, or restricting a sick person from food or anything harmful.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become vehemently hot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a day, oven, sun, fire, iron, or—by a specified animal use—of a horse becoming heated and sweating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become fierce or vehement, especially of a war or fight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from intense heat, used of a severe conflict or event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become hot with anger; to disdain or scorn something, or refuse to tolerate wrongful treatment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction حَمِيَ عَنْهُ or حَمِيَ مِنْهُ expresses disdain, indignation, or refusal to submit to wrong.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exert oneself for someone, especially by honoring and entertaining a guest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction حَامَيْتُ عَلَى ضَيْفِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something vehemently hot or to heat it in fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of making the sun or fire hot, heating iron, or kindling fire upon a branding-iron.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To excite someone to ardor for fighting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative extension in which heat signifies martial eagerness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To guard against, keep aloof from, shun, or avoid someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction تَحَامَاهُ النَّاسُ describes people collectively avoiding or keeping away from an object or person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To protect or defend oneself, or become protected, from something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reflexive construction presents the subject as taking or receiving protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain or abstain from food or from something harmful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of a sick person following a dietary restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become black.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of such things as night or a mass of clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The venom, poison, or painful sting of a scorpion, hornet, serpent, or similar stinging creature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote either the poison or the sting through which it is delivered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehemence of cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independent nominal use, distinct from the venom sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing or area prohibited from approach or use; especially protected pasture, land, or water reserved from the public.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may describe a formally or customarily protected reserve whose grazing or approach is restricted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Protection or restriction; especially abstinence from food or drink that is harmful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used as the verbal noun for protecting or prohibiting a place and for imposing a therapeutic dietary restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A formula meaning ‘a ransom for you’ or ‘may such a person or thing ransom you.’
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expressions حِمَاءٌ لَكَ and حِمَاءً لَكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Protected or guarded from evil; of a sick person, restricted from injurious food or drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of one who is protected or placed under a prohibition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unwilling to bear, endure, or tolerate wrongful treatment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the expression حَمِيُّ الأَنْفِ for a person who refuses submission to wrong.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Care for what is sacred, inviolable, honorable, or connected with religion, together with the resolve to defend it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This protective-care sense is distinct from the Quranic expression for disdainful or partisan pride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vehemence or onset of anger, spirit, or emotional force.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can denote the beginning or outburst of anger and vehement temperament.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The assault, force, or intoxicating influence of wine upon the head; also the onset or attack of pain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the fumes of wine mounting into the head and, by extension, of pain taking hold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The flush, sprightliness, or impetuosity of youth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction حُمَيَّا شَبَابِهِ for the exuberance of someone's youth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A protector, defender, or guardian of what one possesses or manages.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person responsible for safeguarding property or something under his superintendence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate appellational use of the active-participial form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A protector or defender; also a protecting party or the last defenders accompanying a retreating group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a strenuous defender of companions, a defending company, or those covering a party's departure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mighty, forceful, or impetuous in valor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of heat and boiling force, applied to people described through a hot, boiling vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large or heavy stone, or set of stones, used to case and protect the sides of a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may refer collectively to matching casing stones or to large masses placed in the lower or damaged portions of a well casing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rim or side portions of a solid hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the circuit, right and left edges, or corresponding side parts of the hoof.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sides of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the plural form حَوَامٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hearthstone, specifically one of the three stones supporting a cooking pot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested as a singular noun with the corresponding plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One's own way or chosen course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used idiomatically in مَضَيْتُ عَلَى حَامِيَتِي, ‘I went my own way.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: More resistant, more unyielding, or less willing to submit than another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the comparative construction أَحْمَى أَنْفًا مِنْ فُلَانٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black; of a night or mass of clouds, dark and heaped up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive passive-participial form applied especially to dense darkness or piled clouds.

cautions: The Mufradat discussion records حَامِيَةٌ as an alternate reading in 18:86, but that reading is not among the supplied QAC occurrences and is therefore not added to the form's count or examples.

The Mufradat row also contains homographic or differently rooted material concerning حَمَإ/حَمْأ (black mud) and أَحْمَاءُ المرأة (the husband's relatives); these usages are not confidently assignable to canonical root حمي and are excluded from the lexical senses here.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Mufradat row 359 includes the Quranic expression مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ and related حَمْأ material, as well as أَحْمَاءُ المرأة. These appear to involve different final radicals or separate homographic lexical items, so they remain unassigned to canonical root حمي.
